entries.title: Matthew 24:1
segments: Leaving the Temple Courts, Jesus was walking away, when his disciples came up to draw his attention to the Temple buildings.

entries.title: Matthew 24:2
segments: "Do you see all these things?" was his answer. "I tell you, not a single stone will be left here upon another, which will not be throne down,"

entries.title: Matthew 24:3
segments: So, while Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came up to him privately and said: "Tell us when this will be, and what will be the sign of your Coming, and of the close of the age."

entries.title: Matthew 24:4
segments: Jesus replied to them as follows:   "See that no one leads you astray;

entries.title: Matthew 24:5
segments: for, many will take my name, and come saying 'I am the Christ,' and will lead many astray.

entries.title: Matthew 24:6
segments: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars; take care not to be alarmed, for such things must occur; but the end is not yet here.

entries.title: Matthew 24:7
segments: For 'nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom,' and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

entries.title: Matthew 24:8
segments: All this, however, will be but the beginning of the birth pangs!

entries.title: Matthew 24:9
segments: When that time comes, they will give you up to persecution, and will put you to death, and you will be hated by all nations on account of my Name.

entries.title: Matthew 24:10
segments: And then many will fall away, and will betray one another, and hate one another.

entries.title: Matthew 24:11
segments: Many false Prophets, also, will appear and lead many astray;

entries.title: Matthew 24:12
segments: and, owing to the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.

entries.title: Matthew 24:13
segments: Yet the man that endures to the end shall be saved.

entries.title: Matthew 24:14
segments: And this Good News of the Kingdom shall be proclaimed throughout the world as a witness to all nations; and then will come the end.

entries.title: Matthew 24:15
segments: As soon, then, as you see 'the Foul Desecration,' mentioned by the Prophet Daniel, standing in the Holy Place," (the reader must consider what this means)

entries.title: Matthew 24:16
segments: "then those of you who are in Judea must take refuge in the mountains;

entries.title: Matthew 24:17
segments: and a man on the housetop must not go down to get the things that are in his house;

entries.title: Matthew 24:18
segments: nor must one who is on his farm turn back to get his cloak.

entries.title: Matthew 24:19
segments: And alas for the women that are with child, and for those that are nursing infants in those days!

entries.title: Matthew 24:20
segments: Pray, too, that your flight may not take place in winter, nor on a Sabbath;

entries.title: Matthew 24:21
segments: for that will be 'a time of great distress, the like of which has not occurred from the beginning of the world down to the present time'--no, nor ever will again.

entries.title: Matthew 24:22
segments: And had not those days been limited, not a single soul would escape; but for the sake of 'God's People' a limit will be put to them.

entries.title: Matthew 24:23
segments: And, at that time, if any one should say to you 'Look! here is the Christ!' or 'Here he is!', do not believe it;

entries.title: Matthew 24:24
segments: For false Christs and false Prophets will arise, and will display great signs and marvels, so that, were it possible, even God's People would be led astray.

entries.title: Matthew 24:25
segments: Remember, I have told you beforehand.

entries.title: Matthew 24:26
segments: Therefore, if people say to you 'He is in the Wilderness!', do not go out there; or 'He is in an inner room!', do not believe it;

entries.title: Matthew 24:27
segments: For, just as lightning will start from the east and flash across to the west, so will it be with the Coming of the Son of Man.

entries.title: Matthew 24:28
segments: Wherever a dead body lies, there will the vultures flock.'

entries.title: Matthew 24:29
segments: Immediately after the distress of those days, 'the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give her light, the stars will fall from the heavens,' and 'the forces of the heavens will be convulsed.'

entries.title: Matthew 24:30
segments: Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in the heavens; and all the peoples of the earth will mourn, when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the heavens,' with power and great glory;

entries.title: Matthew 24:31
segments: And he will send his angels, with a great trumpet, and they will gather his People round him from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

entries.title: Matthew 24:32
segments: Learn the lesson taught by the fig tree. As soon as its branches are full of sap, and it is bursting into leaf, you know that summer is near.

entries.title: Matthew 24:33
segments: And so may you, as soon as you see all these things, know that he is at your doors.

entries.title: Matthew 24:34
segments: I tell you, even the present generation will not pass away, till all these things have taken place.

entries.title: Matthew 24:35
segments: The heavens and the earth will pass away, but my words shall never pass away.

entries.title: Matthew 24:36
segments: But about that Day and Hour, no one knows--not even the angels of Heaven, nor yet the Son--but only the Father himself.

entries.title: Matthew 24:37
segments: For, just as in the days of Noah, so will it be at the Coming of the Son of Man.

entries.title: Matthew 24:38
segments: In those days before the flood they went on eating and drinking, marrying and being married, up to the very day on which Noah entered the ark,

entries.title: Matthew 24:39
segments: Taking not notice till the flood came and swept them one and all away; and so will it be at the Coming of the Son of Man.

entries.title: Matthew 24:40
segments: At that time, of two men on a farm one will be taken and one left;

entries.title: Matthew 24:41
segments: Of two women grinding with the hand-mill one will be taken and one left.

entries.title: Matthew 24:42
segments: Therefore watch; for you cannot be sure on what day your Master is coming.

entries.title: Matthew 24:43
segments: But this you do know, that, had the owner of the house known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have been on the watch, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

entries.title: Matthew 24:44
segments: Therefore, do you also prepare, since it is just when you are least expecting him that the Son of Man will come.

entries.title: Matthew 24:45
segments: Who, then is that trustworthy, careful servant, who has been placed by his master over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?

entries.title: Matthew 24:46
segments: Happy will that servant be whom his master, when he comes home, shall find doing this.

entries.title: Matthew 24:47
segments: I tell you that his master will put him in charge of the whole of his property.

entries.title: Matthew 24:48
segments: But, should he be a bad servant, and say to himself 'My master is a long time in coming,'

entries.title: Matthew 24:49
segments: And begin to beat his fellow-servants, and eat and drink with drunkards,

entries.title: Matthew 24:50
segments: That servant's master will come on a day when he does not expect him, and at an hour of which he is unaware,

entries.title: Matthew 24:51
segments: And will flog him severely, and assign him his place among the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.
